page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.7xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with 28 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The CPU configuration includes a 40 MB L3 cache and supports AVX, AES, BMI2, and FMA instruction sets. It is equipped with 112.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core.
For acceleration, the instance bundles a single NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPU with 16 GB of VRAM. Local storage consists of a 472 GB SSD, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 5 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear contrast between CPU-only tasks and GPU-accelerated workloads. Single-core CPU performance is poor, placing in the bottom 10% on stress-ng, and single-threaded compression tasks are weak. However, multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations score in the average range. In contrast, the hardware excels at LLM inference, achieving top-tier performance in prompt processing for both 135M and 7B models, as well as text generation for 7B models.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the instance leverages older-generation Intel Xeon and NVIDIA Pascal hardware, offering a balance of dedicated compute resources and GPU acceleration without the premium of current-generation architectures. It is best suited for workloads such as medium-scale LLM inference, machine learning model evaluation, database operations, and multi-threaded data processing.
